prompt: Under Texas Penal Code §49.07, what offense occurs when an intoxicated driver causes serious bodily injury?

options.text: Third-degree felony punishable by 2 to 10 years imprisonment and up to $10,000 fine
Simple misdemeanor traffic infraction settled through automobile insurance claims
Class B misdemeanor punishable by community service and safe driving clinics
Civil administrative penalty involving temporary suspension of license plates
